purpose: Fail-closed persistence anchored to GitHub-returned blob identity instead of model-computed hashes.
protocol_invariants: No immutable artifact may claim a persistence step that occurs after that artifact is created.
RUN_CORE is written exactly once to immutable core/<RUN_ID>.json and identified by the GitHub-returned blob SHA.
History, latest, and finalization reference that same run_core_blob_sha; they do not duplicate or independently hash RUN_CORE.

A v3.2 run is fully persisted only when immutable core, immutable history, current latest, and immutable finalization receipt mutually agree on RUN_ID/control-plane/automation identity and the receipt binds the current core/history/latest blob SHAs.
Scheduler last_run_time is trigger evidence only, never persistence evidence.

first_tool_sequence: inspect prior heartbeat and checkpoint; recover STALE_PRIOR_CYCLE state per single_flight before starting a new run
fetch lane heartbeat.json immediately before write
update heartbeat.json to IN_PROGRESS using that fresh content SHA
re-fetch heartbeat.json and verify exact RUN_ID/control_plane_id/automation_id
write/re-fetch checkpoint.json with BOOTSTRAPPED before substantive work
bootstrap.retry_rule: On conflict/failure, re-fetch heartbeat immediately, reconcile, retry once with the new content SHA.
bootstrap.on_failure: Stop substantive work; attempt minimal Library failure receipt if a writable Library route exists; never claim RUN_PERSISTED.

single_flight.rule: A different RUN_ID heartbeat younger than 40m is ACTIVE and suppresses overlap. Age 40-45m is FINALIZATION_ONLY: do not start new substantive work; prior run must close from its checkpoint. Age >=45m is STALE_PRIOR_CYCLE: preserve heartbeat/checkpoint evidence, record an incident, reset heartbeat safely, and allow the new scheduled run to start. A run must not remain substantively active beyond 35m.
single_flight.scheduler_rule: Scheduler last_run_time is trigger evidence only. Durable repo state remains authoritative for completion.

sequence: Create immutable core/<RUN_ID>.json containing exactly RUN_CORE.
Re-fetch core and record the GitHub-returned run_core_blob_sha.

Create immutable history/<RUN_ID>.json with RUN_STATUS=HISTORY_VERIFIED, PASSES_COMPLETED=9, FINALIZATION_STATUS=AWAITING_LATEST_PROMOTION, RUN_ID/control-plane/automation identity, core_path, and run_core_blob_sha.
Re-fetch history and record the actual history_blob_sha.
pass_9.acceptance_rule: Pass 9 succeeds only when both immutable core and immutable history read back from GitHub and history references the exact current core blob SHA.

sequence: Write/replace latest.json with RUN_STATUS=RUN_PERSISTED, PASSES_COMPLETED=10, FINALIZATION_STATUS=LATEST_VERIFIED_PENDING_RECEIPT, RUN_ID/control-plane/automation identity, core_path, run_core_blob_sha, history_path, and history_blob_sha.
Re-fetch latest, core, and history and verify latest references the actual current core/history blob SHAs.

Create immutable finalization/<RUN_ID>.json with RUN_STATUS=FINALIZATION_VERIFIED, RUN_ID/control-plane/automation identity, core_path/run_core_blob_sha, history_path/history_blob_sha, latest_path/latest_blob_sha, verification timestamp, and returned commit SHAs when available.
Re-fetch finalization receipt and verify all three blob SHAs against current core/history/latest.
Only after receipt verification may heartbeat be updated to IDLE/FINALIZED.
pass_10.acceptance_rule: Fully persisted iff core exists, history=HISTORY_VERIFIED, latest=RUN_PERSISTED, finalization=FINALIZATION_VERIFIED, and the finalization receipt binds the current core/history/latest blob SHAs.

omega_acceptance.current: Accept v3.2 specialist state only when the immutable finalization receipt binds the current core/history/latest blob SHAs.
omega_acceptance.legacy: Pre-v3.2 runs remain historical evidence only unless explicitly migrated and independently verified. Any v3.1 self-hash mismatch or self-claim conflicting with live repo state is QUARANTINED.

fallback.write_route_verification: Disposable canaries were previously uploaded, read back, deleted, and cleanup re-listed successfully for omega, macro, flow, aion, and daedalus state paths.
fallback.on_github_failure: Attempt minimal Library failure receipt containing lane, RUN_ID, timestamp, error, control_plane_id, automation_id; then stop.
fallback.on_library_failure: Emit explicit persistence failure and stop; do not claim RUN_PERSISTED.

watchdog.rule: OMEGA checks heartbeat/checkpoint/core/history/latest/finalization for all lanes. A trigger without a new heartbeat is not a successful run. A stale heartbeat >=45m without a valid finalization receipt is an incident and must be recovered at the lane's next trigger. OMEGA never fabricates missing run content.

sequence: Immediately after verified IN_PROGRESS heartbeat, write checkpoint.json with current RUN_ID, identity, BOOTSTRAPPED, PASSES_COMPLETED=1 and empty/loaded lane payload; re-fetch and verify.
After every material finding, defect, candidate, anomaly, contradiction, or state change, update checkpoint.json before additional non-GitHub retrieval.
At Pass 8 write the complete frozen RUN_CORE to checkpoint.json with CHECKPOINT_STATUS=FROZEN_FOR_FINALIZATION and re-fetch before Pass 9.
After finalization receipt verification set CHECKPOINT_STATUS=FINALIZED with receipt evidence, then set heartbeat IDLE/FINALIZED.
checkpointing.recovery: If a stale prior run has a verified checkpoint but no valid finalization receipt, preserve it as ABORTED_WITH_CHECKPOINT. Never invent missing findings. A fresh run may consume the checkpoint only as historical evidence after freshness/provenance review.

runtime_budget.rule: At or before 35 minutes from started_at_utc, stop all new substantive/external work and enter persistence closure. GitHub persistence/readback calls required for closure are exempt. No lane may intentionally research/code/audit until the next hourly trigger.
runtime_budget.exhaustion_behavior: When a cap is reached, record NO_ADDITIONAL_DELTA_DUE_BUDGET for remaining analytical passes and proceed to Pass 8. Never sacrifice closure for completeness.
